clips.title: The story
paras: At Lake Everstill, Spotted Sunfish draw fishers and hungry murlocs alike. The fish bring trade to Lakeshire, though murlocs make the shallows dangerous.

Spotted Sunfish bring trade to the Lakeshire piers. Dockmaster Baren buys them from the lake's steady catch, supplying food and commerce to a town under strain. Aggressive murloc tribes prowl the shallows and disrupt fishing. They gather sunfish at their camps, where travelers can take the fish by force.
